strategy: Run API checks first, then browser journeys; email delivery is verified manually.

decisions.rationale: Request and response are fully checkable over HTTP.
End-to-end browser journey through the reset form and login.
Needs a real inbox that the test script cannot control.
Response comparison is an HTTP-level check.
The steps exercise client-side form validation in the browser.
Token expiry is enforced by the confirm endpoint.
Single-use enforcement is visible in the confirm endpoint response.
Case handling is checkable through the request endpoint.
